issue_request: FHIR-5361 was a Published/Persuasive January 2015 FHIR-core overview ballot comment for section 1.9.0.2. It reported that the Resource link under the Components heading did not lead to definitions and the approved resolution was to fix the broken link.
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-5361. The matching application appears to be 1f47641cdc1dfceffec70ed5fbb20c0957674289 from 2015-03-12, which changed overview links from resources.html to resource.html; Jira comments two days later state the issue was already fixed.
additional_context: The current overview page is included in the published page list and hierarchy, resource.html is generated from the active abstract Resource infrastructure entry, and formats.html remains the active Resource Definitions background page. A neighboring ballot comment, FHIR-5354, concerns the nearby Resource Definitions link but was not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The seed's current source already preserves the broken-link fix, and adding duplicate or broader overview text would be unnecessary.
